evidence_status: source-derived dispositions; no new test or proof execution
destination_status: planned gates, not evidence of Rust implementation

open_work.title: Canonical bootstrap policy identity
acceptance: Validate and canonicalize new bootstrap policy before deriving its identity.
Preserve original historical policy bytes, identities and signatures.
Re-anchor only through explicit migration; never silently canonicalize retained artifacts.

open_work.title: Partial aggregate incident context readers
acceptance: Aggregate context reading retains valid records and discloses malformed signature/investigation inputs as partial with warnings.
Named-record reads and validate stay strict; missing evidence is never success.
Keep already-fixed impact/match/stale tolerance; do not weaken decoders.

open_work.title: Guarded restore into unborn branches
acceptance: Exercise matching and differing unborn branch names with real Git and native store.
Stage and authenticate complete closure before checkout and visible release publication.
Remove only operation-owned temporary refs on both success and failure; preserve unrelated refs.
Workflow3 restore campaign used knowledge refs without a populated authored branch and does not close this defect.

open_work.title: Typed native-generation availability diagnostics
acceptance: Distinguish absent store, unavailable requested commit/predecessor, permissions, corruption and wrong KB/policy.
Name requested release, exact native generation and configured store.
Never fall back to an older/current release; fetching is conditional advice, not guaranteed repair.

open_work.title: Stable managed authored lock namespace
acceptance: Use Git common-directory managed state, or deterministic configured state for non-Git workspaces, keyed by canonical record/worktree identity.
Readers, writers and recovery share the same stable lock inode namespace; never unlink after unlocking.
Migrate old adjacent locks only when quiescent; reads leave authored tree unchanged.
Preserve conditional writes and interrupted-recovery exclusion.

open_work.title: Supported published-closure replication
acceptance: Support one publishing writer; local flock is not distributed fencing.
Transfer native retained objects and published artifact closure before advertising Git release refs; do not push all candidate branches.
Receive into staging, authenticate history/closure, then conditionally advance visibility.
Exercise two clients, lagging store, half-transfer, conflicting pointer update, relocation and pruning; hosted endpoint policy remains separately qualified.

open_work.title: Portable read-only replicas and writer ownership
acceptance: Separate logical KB/trust identity from writer-instance ownership.
Read construction must not initialize operations, claim ownership or recover mutations.
Enforce capability at CLI, RPC and embedding boundaries, not only by hiding commands.
Block capture, propose/sign/admit, selection, migration, restore and recovery under read-only capability.
Replica refresh is an explicit mutation; ordinary reads never implicitly sync.

open_work.title: Strict version and executable identity admission
acceptance: Admit exact executable content, tool version and installation provenance; same version text with changed executable is not same tool.
Strict parse and duplicate/conflicting version-line refusal are not provided by the existing permissive regex.
Preserve completed warning exclusion; do not reopen it as the remaining parser task.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Strict readiness and named failures; explicit adoption routes
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Do not waive decided-status predicates for legacy flat files. Draft/proposed may adopt; accepted/landing must reopen; finalized records require supersession. Preserve named failures.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Closed evidence-address relationship references
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Accept evidence record or exact code locator, reject bare prose/slugs; retain reverse navigation.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Existing tolerant aggregate readers
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: impact/match/stale retain valid results, warnings and exit 2 on malformed records; strict named/validate readers unchanged. Broader context gap remains FR8.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Located malformed citation scanning
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Malformed tokens are located; later tokens still scanned; cite check unverifiable exits 3, cite stale non-clean exits 2. Duplicate and unterminated structures remain refused.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Safe non-Markdown symlink skipping
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Skip implicitly encountered non-Markdown links unread. Explicit, ancestor and Markdown-suffixed links remain refused; no promise of following directory links or respecting gitignore.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: No ignored explain pagination options
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: knowledge explain exposes request/release only, not ignored limit/continuation options.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Separate gate binding from repository evidence
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Compute gate table digest in rev; retain supplied --rev verbatim as repo_rev; adding profile on first write must not self-invalidate gate binding.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Every failing assignment has assessment attribution
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Preserve named stale/unsupported/inapplicable gaps and schema3 all-assignment claim/context attribution. Earlier C11 partial diagnosis was superseded by FR4 follow-through.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Bounded read-only descriptor ownership
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Read each read-only leaf once then release descriptor. Write-back retains descriptors intentionally; raising fd limits or claiming unlimited mutation batches is not the fix.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Fix reference closed union
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: ProposalId | EvidenceAddress, explicit fixed_at, advisory regression only; writers/readers/reverse queries/graph agree; citation or PR is not proof of successful fix.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Exact local commit-diff retrieval
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Resolve two local endpoints once; no fetch/external diff/textconv/worktree substitution/triple-dot. Preserve both hunk coordinates, unmapped historical pins, no invented binary/mode spans, no_release and omissions, one pinned context-claim release.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Named authorized portfolios
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Preserve ordered context family, exact appended-claim assignments, explicit retirement, all-context key uses, no pooling, exact replay and current correction history under retained selection. v2 history stays authenticated read-only.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Design acceptance independent of implementation binding
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Preserve actual source resolution, accepted design identity, conditional mutation, old-target gate history without authority, explicit reopen, and finalized supersession.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Stable graph provenance despite upgrade warnings
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Keep only version-line match in graph identity; unrelated upgrade advice cannot change inputs. Current regex is permissive: strict parser, multiple-line rejection and executable-byte identity remain new Rust admission obligations.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Private native reader descendant lifetime
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Keep DOLT_DISABLE_EVENT_FLUSH=1 scoped to private reader subprocesses; reap owned child before deleting private files. Do not substitute cleanup retries/suppression or mutate user configuration; full cancellation ownership still requires Rust qualification.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Disjoint design projection and preserved unknown metadata
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Retain long inline gate tables, historical custom-field materiality, design-v3 prefix, and refusal to infer missing acceptor from legacy attribution. No old binding-like field gains authority.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Workflow reference request ID agreement
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Both reference schema2/schema3 require nonempty ID. Retain Lean decoder counterpart and counterexample; production RPC ID rules are a different surface.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Proposition-specific leaves and recursive finite witnesses
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Preserve exact attestation leaves, every recursive premise, independent inventory/finite-domain interpretation, four-valued support and alternative derivations; do not restore v1 blanket truth premise.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: No false coverage, scope widening or self-issued approval
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Full-plan equality controls replay; context/authority verification is adapter-derived; rejection preserves state/journal. Coverage and scope are not widened by navigation or empty inventory.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Pinned complete native graphs and owner isolation
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: No mutable working-state or null/incomplete-current reads; preserve cross-KB ownership, predecessor publication, retained rebuild history and exact binding parity, not count-only parity.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Historical citation coordinates and times remain original
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Original rev/blob/span/L/seen and state remain historical; current locations/checks are separate advisory fields.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Contained source acquisition and worktree provenance
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Preserve containment, source identity and source-movement checks; do not execute repository-controlled helpers. Worktree profile includes declared staged/unstaged/untracked/binary/submodule bytes rather than HEAD alone.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Unicode scalar and deep malformed RPC refusal
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Reject lone UTF-16 surrogate semantic inputs; bounded malformed/deep RPC frames must not terminate the server or fabricate successful response.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Decoder and new modules change generation identity
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Hash complete installed package, including unloaded modules without importing them. Missing source/version is not a shared fallback identity.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Recoverable correction projections
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Persist operation intent before review projections; same operation/input is replayable and conflicting reuse rejected; preserve pending reviews across partial writes.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Isolated regex redaction
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Keep fixed isolated worker, bounded input/runtime and fail-closed redaction; source text never becomes executable helper code.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Revalidate complete signed operation on recovery
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Journal hints are not authority: recheck plan, approval, policy, captures, native closure, manifest linkage and predecessor; never assume a hinted successful publication.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Concurrent qualification output capture repair
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Independent bounded capture files and supervised child cleanup replace serialized pipe waits that deadlocked competing publishers. Retain failed original campaign and repair evidence separately; harness revision is not runtime proof.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Historical trial excludes later correction
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Old-release payload must bind old revision, exclude later correction and future observations; preserve corpus correction lineage and failed earlier reports.

preserved_completed_fixes.title: Explicit evidence identity in synthetic notes
preserved_completed_fixes.preservation_contract: Corpus 1.0.2 adds evidence_id separate from ticket target without label/prompt/threshold changes. Keep original 0/48 exact-label failures and later baseline-only atlas-07 failure; never relabel strict importer as passing.

non_defect_dispositions.contract: deferred proposal lifecycle is not a new land/deploy/use gate timing
no legacy decided-status exemption or inferred acceptor; preserve strict readiness and explicit migration

non_defect_dispositions.disposition: policy disclosure, not TTL calculus defect
non_defect_dispositions.contract: signed per-context TTL changes policy, not observation time; disclose old/new TTL/source/policy without fabricated claim edits

qualification_limits.contract: Only 24 synthetic tasks across atlas/boreal are frozen. No representative production corpus, provider-resolved model identity or token accounting is supplied.

Existing synthetic ratios remain frozen; cold install/open, cancellation, full history, extraction, peak simultaneous RSS, storage growth and proof/build resource budgets require actual admitted hardware/input profile before optimization. Do not fabricate thresholds or infer them from historical timing.
qualification_limits.acceptance_prerequisite: Freeze additional budgets under the owner-reviewed scope on the actual admitted hardware before optimization; this inventory does not invent machine limits.

qualification_limits.contract: Workflow3 knowledge campaign is narrower than full storage/remote gates; retain input hashes and source-delta limits. Hosted endpoint authentication/retention, power loss and hostile same-user writers remain separate claims.
Source-owned v2/v3 canonical/signature domains are frozen; cross-host golden byte/signature execution remains P02.

documentation_rule: Historical reports are retained input artifacts, not freshly executed passes; new Rust stages remain subject to their own exact-source gate receipts.
